integrity_notes: An all-field proof uses an exhaustively checked Newton-polygon reduction, the degree-six intersection bound, and an exact complete F_5 rank census; the independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The formulas concern d_3 through d_7 of the seven-character dense-torus anticanonical code of the split degree-six toric del Pezzo surface over prime powers q>=5. They do not assert weights for the full projective surface, nonsplit forms, or q<5. Earlier d_1 and d_2 are not new.
title: Higher generalized weights of the degree-six toric del Pezzo anticanonical code
